name: Please read!!  FlexRadio flow V10
info:
FlexRadio version 10 flow


Set up the Flex-request, Flex-status, 
Flex-message, and Flex-meter nodes. 
Click the pulldown for the IP address 
and select Add New Radio. 
Click the pencil to edit the new radio. 
Click the pulldown and select manual if you have more than one radio on the network. Enter the IP address for your radio. 

For the remaining Flex nodes click the 
pulldown and select your radio's IP address. The IP address of your radio can be found in SmartSDR under settings/radio setup/Networking.

Set the PING node to the IP address of your radio.

I highly suggest in your router 
you make a DHCP reservation for the 
radio so that it always gets the same 
IP address assigned. Google router DHCP 
reservation for more info.

Dave wo2x
